g.text: Domain: this zero-count test applies only to odd n > 1. 0 and 1 are neither; 2 is prime; larger evens are composite.

g.text: Colors identify factors—not zeta quadrants. Exact divisor enumeration; no new speed advantage or Riemann Hypothesis result is claimed.
